RESPONSIVE Linked390/320 jobs handle compact field order/drawer/stacking and safe scrolling.

Brand is DooKnow; ToDoo is an existing app and style reference only.
No invented fields, actions, role hierarchy, authentication gate, password sharing gate, automatic save guarantee or backend expansion.

EXECUTION CLARIFICATIONS FROM EXISTING SOURCE: Show one populated directory table only. Use breadcrumb 30-Knowledge / 方法, title 方法, count 1 个文件夹 · 2 篇笔记. Keep source columns 名称 / 类型 / 修改时间 and trailing row 更多操作 icon. Three fictional rows 学习资料 (文件夹), 阅读方法.md (Markdown), 整理记录.md (Markdown). Buttons 新建笔记 / 新建文件夹 / 导入 Markdown. Under table preserve source neutral helper 选择文件即可打开编辑. No extra input, sort menu, checkbox or automatic-save status.
FLAT VISUAL CONTRACT: Match the actual ToDoo reference solely for style. Brand DooKnow and source-owned knowledge controls only. Flat solid #ffffff main/header, #f7f8fa sidebar, #272b3a text, #657084 secondary, #e6e9f1 thin borders, #4566c6 primary, #edf1ff selected. Crisp sans-serif Chinese, thin line icons, 8px radii, restrained shadows. No gradient, texture, grain, glow, bevel or illustration. Desktop primary rail approximately 64px, global header 56px, existing knowledge sidebar approximately 260px with resize divider retained; width is a visual suggestion only, not removal of resizing. Full desktop app host and no browser/device chrome. Source existing owner rail only: O account avatar; 笔记 / 最近 / 收藏 / 应用, bottom 回收站 / 设置. Existing sidebar has 搜索笔记与目录, 新建 split control, heading and add-folder/refresh controls unless source active state suppresses them. Do not transfer ToDoo tasks, goal fields, calendar, notifications or extra navigation. Caption source ID, title, authenticated owner, and the selected visible state only in a separate narrow outer margin.
